move: axis draws, pictures slide to centre from both halves, words swap, fold
how: The frame is two 540px halves, the right one CSS-mirrored with scaleX(-1) (its text is flipped back), so every move on the left is reflected on the right. A centre axis line scales y from 0 (expo.inOut 0.8s), a logo drops from y -100 with back.out(2) and a label fades. The first picture slides toward the axis from xPercent -110 (expo.out 0.9s) and the first word rises masked from yPercent 110; all inner images drift xPercent -3→3 linearly for the whole duration. At 37% and 65% a swap: the current picture pushes on to xPercent 20 while the next slides in to 0 (both expo.inOut 0.7s), the current word exits upward with expo.in and the next rises with expo.out. Exit at 87%: all pictures slide back out to xPercent -110 with expo.in, the last word exits, tag/label/logo fade and the axis scales back to 0.
adapt: Replace the three pictures and three words (both halves carry the same markup), the tag, label and logo; keep the 0.9s slide, the swaps at 1.5s and 2.6s and the 0.7s expo.inOut push.
port: mount(el, shot) builds both halves with identical children, the axis and centre block, and applies the sets (absolute word spans, flipped right tag); animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with entrance 0-0.25D, swaps at 0.375D and 0.65D, exit at 0.875D. The half widths assume a 1080px stage, so size them from el; selectors el-scoped; from() tweens need immediateRender:false.
caveats: half widths and the axis position are hard-coded to a 1080px stage
